selection_rule: Include a topic only when at least one supplied JD requests it and README/source confirms the project implements the relevant capability.

intersections.topic: Agent Runtime, prompting, business tools, Skills
Long running state, approvals, recovery, reliability
Product vector search, hybrid retrieval, reranking, hard constraint checks
Personal shopping preference Memory: extraction, storage, retrieval, update/delete, injection
Agent and Memory evaluation entry points and limits

excluded_jd_topics_not_taught: SFT, RLHF, PPO, DPO, GRPO, DAPO, GSPO model training or policy optimization
Multimodal data pipelines and robot control
Generic event or temporal Memory, automatic consolidation/forgetting, AIOps/DevOps Memory

project_limits: The project stores explicit stable shopping preferences; it is not a general event or temporal Memory system.
Hybrid retrieval is implemented but disabled by default and has no established quality gain.
Memory and Agent evaluation entry points do not establish production acceptance.
